This aluminium spiral lightweight composite hose is for delivery and suction of fuels, oils and lubricants in tank trucks, wagons and plants. With aluminium inner and outer spirals it is significantly lighter and easier to handle, especially in large diameters. It is a 10 bar class in 2 to 4 inch.

Construction

  • Liner: Polypropylene
  • Inner spiral: aluminium
  • Outer spiral: aluminium
  • Cover: PVC-coated polyester fabric
  • Safety factor 5:1; vacuum rating 0.9 bar; temperature -30 °C to +100 °C
  • Polypropylene liner; aluminium inner and outer spirals

No. The liner is polypropylene like the other lightweight fuel hose. The difference lies in the spirals, which are aluminium inside and out. Weight runs from 0.8 kg/m at 2 inch to 2.5 kg/m at 4 inch. That is lower at every size than the aluminium-and-galvanised version, which runs 0.9 to 2.94 kg/m. The maker says the saving is most noticeable in large diameters.

Applications

Media listed: fuels, oils and lubricants.

  • Tank truck loading
  • Rail wagon transfer
  • Plant transfer
  • Hose reels
  • Marine transfer

Sizes and ratings

A size table follows with 4 part numbers, from 2" (DN50) to 4" (DN100). Working pressure is 10 bar, built to EN 13765. Minimum bend radius runs from 150 to 320 mm and weight from 0.8 to 2.5 kg per metre, by size. Standard coil length is 30 m; other lengths on request. There is one 10 bar class across the four sizes, 2 to 4 inch.

Ordering

To quote this lightweight fuel and lubricant composite hose with aluminium spirals, send the fuel or oil, the size (2 to 4 inch), the length and whether it is for a hose reel, plus the size, working pressure, length, end connections and quantity. Supplied from Dubai, UAE; availability and lead time are confirmed at quotation.
